description: This is the main application component for a React-based notes app. It manages state for notes, search text, and dark mode, and renders child components for header, search, and notes list. It also handles local storage persistence and note addition/deletion.

methods.name: addNote
methods.description: Creates a new note with a unique ID, current date, and provided text, then adds it to the notes state.

methods.name: deleteNote
methods.description: Removes a note from the notes state based on its ID.
